secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
secrets.description: Cloudinary cloud name for file/image storage (Cloudinary dashboard)

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID (Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials)

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret (Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials)

secrets.name: EMAIL
secrets.description: Email address for Nodemailer (e.g. Gmail address)

secrets.name: PASSWORD
secrets.description: Email app password for Nodemailer (e.g. Gmail app password)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_TENOR_API_KEY
secrets.description: Tenor GIF API key (Google Cloud Console > Tenor API)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase web API key (Firebase Console > Project Settings)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN
secrets.description: Firebase auth domain (Firebase Console > Project Settings)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase project ID (Firebase Console > Project Settings)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET
secrets.description: Firebase storage bucket (Firebase Console > Project Settings)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID
secrets.description: Firebase messaging sender ID (Firebase Console > Project Settings > Cloud Messaging)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID
secrets.description: Firebase app ID (Firebase Console > Project Settings)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MEASUREMENT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase measurement ID (Firebase Console > Project Settings > Analytics)

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_VAPID_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase VAPID key for push notifications (Firebase Console > Project Settings > Cloud Messaging)
